acceptanceCriteria: Before checkpoint a Work Item may append declared scope only through Runtime and receives an append-only declaration receipt.
After checkpoint existing amendment and revalidation requirements remain fail-closed.
Unsupported Contract fields and identity or authority changes remain rejected.

A Runtime-authorized retry from finish_ready to checkpointed may refresh stale verification evidence without a second preflight, while an unbound stale snapshot remains rejected before process execution.
goal: 允许在尚未开始验证且 Contract 身份未变时安全追加缺失 scope；仍禁止变更 authority、base、已有验收、以及 checkpoint 后无再验证的 scope 扩张。
intent: 修复未 checkpoint 的 Work Item 无法补充前检必需 scope 的生命周期循环。

scenarioCoverage.expected: A not-yet-checkpointed Work Item can add only declared scope through the Runtime when the original Contract has no verification evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use a repository fixture to amend scope before checkpoint and then checkpoint successfully.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A checkpointed Work Item retains the existing revalidation and evidence invalidation requirements.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise a checkpointed fixture and assert the existing amendment receipt and revalidation behavior.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Scope amendment cannot alter identity, authority, base, mode, or prior acceptance criteria.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Attempt unsupported or immutable-field amendments and assert fail-closed rejection.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A bound retry permits the replacement verification after snapshot drift; without its recovery binding, preflight drift still prevents process execution.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise require_verification_preconditions with a Runtime-bound retry receipt and a changed repository snapshot.
